stem: Which statement about f(x) = 2x^2 - 3x - 5 is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The zeros are -\frac{5}{2} and -1, because f(x) = (x + 1)(2x + 5).

options.label: B
options.text: The zeros are -\frac{5}{2} and 1, because f(x) = (x - 1)(2x + 5).

options.label: C
options.text: The zeros are -1 and \frac{5}{2}, because f(x) = (x + 1)(2x - 5).

options.label: D
options.text: The zeros are 1 and \frac{5}{2}, because f(x) = (x - 1)(2x - 5).
